tools.name: add
tools.handler: const a = params.a || 0; const b = params.b || 0; const result = a + b; return { success: true, output: result.toString(), result, operation: 'add' };

tools.name: multiply
tools.handler: const a = params.a || 0; const b = params.b || 0; const result = a * b; return { success: true, output: result.toString(), result, operation: 'multiply' };

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Calculate basic statistics on an array of numbers
tools.handler: const numbers = params.numbers || []; if (numbers.length === 0) { return { success: false, error: 'Array is empty' }; } const sum = numbers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); const avg = sum / numbers.length; const min = Math.min(...numbers); const max = Math.max(...numbers); return { success: true, output: JSON.stringify({ sum, avg, min, max, count: numbers.length }), stats: { sum, avg, min, max, count: numbers.length } };
